messages:
samira: Hey — PR #17999 CI is failing intermittently on the embedding-index e2e. 1/6 shards failed on the dedicated runners. Can someone approve a targeted rerun (shard 4) or advise if we should update the snapshot? Logs pasted below.

ci-bot: Buildkite report: PR #17999 — shard 4 failed (1/6 shards). <https://buildkite.com/redwood/prs/17999|buildkite link>

ryan: Can you paste the failing snippet? quick check first.

samira: Sure — here's the failing assertion from shard 4:
```
FAIL: test_embedding_index_integration (tests.e2e.test_index.TestIndex)
AssertionError: Expected 42 vectors, got 41
  File \"tests/e2e/test_index.py\", line 128, in test_embedding_index_integration
    self.assertEqual(len(indexed), 42)
```
Looks nondeterministic; sometimes it passes on rerun.

oliver: If it's flaky, prefer rerun first (no snapshot update). Command to run a targeted shard rerun:  `buildkite-agent build retry --build 17999 --job shard-4` or from UI trigger "Retry job" on shard-4.

vika: I can approve the rerun from the approval queue but I'd rather not approve a merge until we get consistent green. :+1:

samira: Ok I'll request the rerun and hold merge. @ryan can you watch and merge if everything stabilizes during the merge window?

ryan: Yep, I'll watch. Trigger it now if someone can approve.

ci-bot: Rerun requested: PR #17999 shard-4 (triggered by samira). Waiting on manual approval to start the job.

vika: Approving rerun now.

ci-bot: Rerun started (attempt 1) — https://buildkite.com/redwood/prs/17999/jobs/shard-4-attempt-1

ryan: Quick update: attempt 1 failed again (same assertion). Attempt 2 in flight.

ci-bot: Rerun started (attempt 2) — https://buildkite.com/redwood/prs/17999/jobs/shard-4-attempt-2

ryan: Attempt 2 passed, but we still had a flake earlier in attempt 1 on the same shard. I'm going to kick one more targeted rerun to be safe.

vika: Approving second rerun. go for it. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Rerun started (attempt 3) — all shards running.

ci-bot: Final status: PR #17999 — all shards passed on attempt 3 ✅

samira: Awesome, thanks everyone — I'll merge now and add a small note on the PR about the intermittent embedding-index flake and follow up with a short ticket to add extra logging around index writes. :rocket:

ryan: Thanks — will monitor for any recurring flakes and follow up in the tracking ticket.

oliver: If it recurs, we should add a targeted assertion retry or more robust waiting in the e2e.

samira: Agreed. I'll open the ticket. Thanks all!
